title: Senior Strategic Consultant Professional Services
description:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

About the job

The Professional Services team helps Contentsquare customers turn digital experience data into measurable business outcomes. As a Senior Strategic Consultant, you will be a senior, client-facing consultant responsible for delivering strategic, analytical, and enablement services to enterprise customers. You will combine consulting expertise, project management, digital analytics knowledge, and Contentsquare expertise to help customers understand their digital experience, prioritize opportunities, and take action.

You will work across two types of engagements:

  1. One-off consulting missions, where you lead and deliver a defined project (analysis, workshop, training..)

  2. Managed-services engagements, where you act as the delivery owner and project manager for an ongoing customer relationship. You will manage the service roadmap, coordinate contributors, maintain delivery momentum, and proactively ensure that the customer receives value from the available services.

You will operate as a trusted advisor to customer teams, including operational stakeholders, analytics teams, technical teams, and senior or economic buyers. You will work closely with Customer Success Manager and Sales but also all your Professional Services colleagues such as Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants..

This role is ideal for someone who combines the structure and client leadership of a senior consultant with the curiosity and practical fluency of a digital analytics power user.

If you are not located in the offer’s specified location, the role is open to fully remote work within the country mentioned in the job posting.

Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

About the job

The Professional Services team helps Contentsquare customers turn digital experience data into measurable business outcomes. As a Senior Strategic Consultant, you will be a senior, client-facing consultant responsible for delivering strategic, analytical, and enablement services to enterprise customers. You will combine consulting expertise, project management, digital analytics knowledge, and Contentsquare expertise to help customers understand their digital experience, prioritize opportunities, and take action.

You will work across two types of engagements:

  1. One-off consulting missions, where you lead and deliver a defined project (analysis, workshop, training..)

  2. Managed-services engagements, where you act as the delivery owner and project manager for an ongoing customer relationship. You will manage the service roadmap, coordinate contributors, maintain delivery momentum, and proactively ensure that the customer receives value from the available services.

You will operate as a trusted advisor to customer teams, including operational stakeholders, analytics teams, technical teams, and senior or economic buyers. You will work closely with Customer Success Manager and Sales but also all your Professional Services colleagues such as Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants..

This role is ideal for someone who combines the structure and client leadership of a senior consultant with the curiosity and practical fluency of a digital analytics power user.

If you are not located in the offer’s specified location, the role is open to fully remote work within the country mentioned in the job posting.

About the Team

The UX Research team partners directly with Product and UX Design from early opportunity discovery and ideation through delivery. This role supports the Integrated Care portfolio, including products serving acute and payer markets and healthcare and financial workflows such as Prior Authorization and Concurrent Review. The team keeps product and design decisions moving with timely, actionable customer insights.

Position Summary:

The Senior UX Researcher drives strategic and tactical product decisions by planning and conducting research, usability studies, and mixed-method discovery. Working directly with Product and UX Design, this role identifies the right participants, recommends fit-for-purpose methodologies, recruits and conducts studies, synthesizes qualitative and quantitative findings, and translates insights into strategy and design recommendations. The Senior UX Researcher also provides project leadership and communicates research decisions and outcomes to leadership and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Product and UX Design at the beginning of projects, opportunities, and ideation to formulate discovery plans, identify the right customers and stakeholders to engage, and recommend appropriate research methodologies.
  • Lead end-to-end research activities, including participant recruitment, discussion guide development, study facilitation, analysis, synthesis, and sharing findings. Methods may include surveys, in-depth interviews, remote feedback, usability testing, and prototype-based research when appropriate.
  • Conduct user outreach, use-case discovery, persona and journey mapping, validation, and usability studies using unbiased and standardized research practices.
  • Translate customer feedback and research data into actionable insights and strategy and design recommendations for Product, UX Design, Engineering, and other stakeholders.
  • Lead or participate in workshops, communicate strategic research decisions to leadership, and provide project leadership to researchers and designers on assigned initiatives.
  • Collaborate with internal subject matter experts, Customer Success, Data Science, and Customer Insights to strengthen understanding of personas, journeys, and use cases and encourage adoption of research best practices.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience as a UX researcher or in a similar customer-focused research role.
  • Bachelor’s degree in psychology, statistics, human-computer interaction, information systems, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to create research strategy and discovery plans, develop discussion guides, select methodologies, conduct interviews and studies, and quickly analyze and synthesize findings.
  • Strong qualitative and quantitative research skills, with the ability to translate real user feedback into insights that drive user-centered decisions for broad audiences.
  • Experience with research and survey tools such as Dovetail, User Interviews, Salesforce, SurveyMonkey, Qualtrics, and analytics or product-experience platforms such as Pendo.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain strategic decisions, present findings, persuade, negotiate, and articulate alternative approaches.
  • Ability to travel to customer sites on a limited basis, approximately four times per year.
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude and Microsoft Copilot to enable day-to-day research work.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience researching healthcare, medical, regulated, payer, acute-care, or financial applications.
  • Experience collaborating in Figma and Miro; this role contributes to prototype-based research but is not expected to create prototypes.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across Product, UX Design, Engineering, Customer Success, Data Science, Customer Insights, and internal subject matter experts to advance user-centered outcomes.

title: Talent Management Partner
description:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Who You Are:

The Talent Management Partner will independently own execution of workstreams across performance, careers, compensation, and broader talent initiatives. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong analytical capability with sound judgment and can support translation of talent problems into scalable solutions, through close partnership with PBPs and functional leaders.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Performance & Careers

  • Apply established job evaluation frameworks to evaluate roles, document rationale, and flag cases requiring calibration for levelling decisions.
  • Maintain job architectures, career paths, level descriptors and progression criteria; incorporate approved changes and maintain version control/source of truth.
  • Partner with People Business Partners (PBPs) to track architecture gaps and recommend changes when the nature or complexity of work materially evolves.
  • Independently own execution of assigned modules during performance and promotion review cycles.
  • Analyze talent outcomes to identify patterns, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.

Compensation & Rewards

  • Conduct market benchmarking using global data platforms to support compensation recommendations.
  • Analyze compensation and talent data to support pay range design, hiring, retention, promotion, and workforce decisions.
  • Apply established compensation principles consistently while identifying and escalating exceptions, inconsistencies, and emerging organizational patterns.
  • Maintain equity/rewards datasets, run defined analyses and support reporting for strategic rewards initiatives.

Project Coordination & Data Analytics

  • Maintain project plans, trackers, dependencies, schedules and completion reporting across talent management initiatives.
  • Build scalable dashboards and standardized reporting templates across initiatives.
  • Use Apps Script, GPT/API-based workflows and other automation tools to reduce manual work across recurring analysis, reporting, data validation and talent operations.
  • Build and maintain automated data pipelines between talent datasets and reporting outputs, with appropriate data quality and exception flags.

Stakeholder Consulting

  • Serve as the first point of support for PBPs on established talent processes, data and frameworks; resolve standard queries and escalate judgment-heavy cases.
  • Analyze issues, validate data and develop options/inputs for decision-making.
  • Maintain documentation and templates that enable consistent application of Talent Management processes.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in Talent Management, Compensation/Rewards, People Consulting, Performance, Organization Design, or related disciplines.
  • Hands-on compensation experience across market benchmarking, salary structures and pay design.
  • Working knowledge of job evaluation methodologies, such as Aon, Korn Ferry/Hay, Mercer IPE, or equivalent.
  • Strong analytical and modeling capability with advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills and the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations.
  • Aptitude to create basic Appscript/ChatGPT API-Based workflows to reduce manual effort in recurring tasks.
  • Knowledge of career architecture, leveling, performance, and organization design principles.
  • Strong stakeholder consulting and communication to explain complex concepts clearly.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and exercise sound judgment when applying talent and compensation principles.
  • Experience working in a global workforce.

Preferred

  • Experience in talent/rewards consulting, including Mercer, Aon, WTW, Korn Ferry, Big 4 People Advisory, or similar.
  • Experience in SaaS, technology, or another high-growth environment.
  • Exposure to equity compensation, global compensation, or pay-equity analysis.
  • Experience designing or scaling enterprise career, performance, or talent frameworks.

title: Product Designer, Roundtripping (London, United Kingdom)
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We're looking for a technically-minded product designer who is excited to shape how design, code, and AI-powered workflows come together at Figma. In this role, you'll improve how Figma understands production code and design systems, design workflows that move from design to code and back again, and extend Figma's agentic capabilities into developer tools and the places teams already work. You'll turn ambiguity into clarity alongside engineers, PMs, and researchers, bringing simplicity and craft to complex technical problems as we help define the future of how software is made.

This is a full-time role that can be held from our London hub or remotely within the UK.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Shape and prototype new workflows that bring design and production code closer together, including AI-powered experiences that connect Figma with the tools teams already use to build
  • Contribute to overall strategy and decision-making about product direction
  • Help deliver and refine clear storytelling around product needs and opportunities
  • Work cross-functionally with product management, engineering, UX writing, data science, and research peers
  • Create and iterate on flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals, as well as provide thoughtful feedback for others doing the same so you can all do your best work
  • Design and ship high-quality features and product improvements in Figma's core product surfaces
  • Contribute to our design org's culture by participating in design critiques, mentoring peers, and sharing best practices across teams

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 3+ years of experience designing UX and UI for software products of similar scale and complexity
  • Strong visual craft and attention to detail across composition, typography, layout, interaction design, and prototyping
  • Proven ability to independently drive end-to-end design processes from discovery through launch, balancing user needs, technical constraints, and business goals
  • Ability to guide decision-making through structured thinking, clear design rationale, and user-centered research
  • Experience designing technically complex products, ideally developer tools or extensible platforms, with an understanding of software development workflows, APIs, and systems; experience prototyping and evaluating AI-powered or nondeterministic interactions is a plus

While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:

  • Familiarity with web technologies like HTML/CSS, AI coding tools such as Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code
  • A strong understanding of advanced Figma features like Auto Layout, Variables, and Components
  • Hands-on experience building with web technologies, APIs, CLIs, MCP, model evals, or other tools used to create developer and AI products
  • A history of working on canvas-based interfaces or tools that support creative workflows
  • Prior work involving design systems, like creating, maintaining, or contributing to a design system

You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Technical Operations Analyst, User Safety & Risk
description:
About the Team

At OpenAI, our User Safety & Risk Operations (USRO) team helps protect our products and users from abuse, fraud, safety risks, and other forms of misuse. We operate at the front line of real-world safety and risk management, translating user and operational signals into timely decisions, effective interventions, and improvements to our systems.

Within USRO, Risk Incubation & Systems builds the analytics, automation, monitoring, quality mechanisms, and operating systems that help teams identify risk, make sound decisions, and scale safely.

Our work spans emerging-risk detection, operational measurement, workflow automation, quality systems, launch readiness, and decision-support tools. We partner closely with operational teams as well as Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Policy, Safety, Legal, and Support to identify high-leverage opportunities and build practical systems that improve outcomes.

About the Role

We are hiring a Technical Operations Analyst to solve ambiguous, high-impact operational problems using data, technical tools, and strong judgment. You will work as an experienced individual contributor across USRO, moving from problem definition through analysis, workflow design, implementation, measurement, and handoff.

The scope is intentionally broad and may span emerging-risk detection, operational quality, automation, launch readiness, and other priority programs. You will be expected to move between different problem areas as organizational needs evolve.

This is a hands-on role. You should be comfortable querying and validating data, building dashboards and lightweight automations, using AI tools to accelerate work, and working directly with operators and technical partners to turn incomplete information into practical systems.

Your work may also include data and operational monitoring issues for major cloud deployment partnerships—for example, validating pipelines and safety signals, investigating anomalies or discrepancies, improving reporting and escalation mechanisms, and documenting data limitations so partner teams can act with confidence.

Location / work model: London, UK; hybrid, 3 days/week in-office.

Please note: This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning content. Strong discretion, judgment, and resilience are essential.

In This Role, You Will

  • Independently scope ambiguous operational problems and frontier & emerging risks, and turn them into clear analyses, workflows, tools, or decision systems.

  • Analyze large and complex datasets to identify patterns, data-quality gaps, operational blind spots, and source-of-truth issues.

  • Build and maintain dashboards, monitoring, alerts, recurring reporting, and workflow automations.

  • Develop systems for detecting and assessing emerging risks, including classifier, evaluation, labeling, and human-review feedback loops.

  • Support major cloud deployments and partnerships by validating data pipelines and safety signals, investigating anomalies, and improving operational monitoring, reporting, and escalation.

  • Design practical quality controls such as sampling plans, golden datasets, validation holdouts, thresholds, human review, and fallback paths.

  • Use AI and LLM-based tools to improve speed and scale while applying appropriate testing, quality assurance, and human oversight.

  • Translate technical and operational findings into clear recommendations, tradeoffs, decisions, and next steps for partner teams.

  • Partner across Operations, Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Policy, Safety, Legal, and Support to define ownership, requirements, and durable handoffs.

  • Document system logic, limitations, operating procedures, and maintenance expectations so others can run and improve the work.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You

  • Have 5+ years of experience in technical operations, data analytics, trust and safety, risk operations, product operations, or a related field.

  • Are strong in SQL and comfortable working with unfamiliar datasets, schemas, joins, denominators, and data-quality issues.

  • Have built practical dashboards, tools, automations, or operating systems and owned them from initial scoping through adoption and maintenance.

  • Can use AI and LLM tools to accelerate real workflows while independently validating outputs and managing failure modes.

  • Understand how to measure technical or operational systems using concepts such as precision, recall, coverage, error analysis, quality assurance, and human review.

  • Exercise sound judgment in scaled operations, including queues, escalations, reviewer workflows, capacity, quality, and incident response.

  • Move quickly in ambiguous environments, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and create structure without waiting for perfect requirements.

  • Communicate complex findings clearly to technical, operational, and leadership audiences and drive work through cross-functional partners.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in trust and safety, fraud, scaled or adversarial abuse, integrity, emerging-risk detection, or other high-stakes operational domains.

  • Experience supporting cloud, enterprise, or privacy-preserving deployments with constrained data access or specialized monitoring requirements.

  • Experience with classifiers, evaluations, golden datasets, labeling programs, reviewer calibration, or model-quality measurement.

  • Experience with Python, notebooks, data-pipeline troubleshooting, or other lightweight technical development.

  • Experience designing quality systems or workflows that involve vendors, BPOs, or distributed operational teams.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

description:

title: Enforcement Operations Lead, Cloud Partners
region: San Francisco, CA / New York City, NY / Washington, DC
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic's Safeguards team is responsible for enforcing our policies, protecting users, and ensuring our platform is not misused. A large and growing share of Claude usage reaches customers through our cloud partners: Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry. As the Enforcement Operations Lead for Multi-Cloud, you'll own how Anthropic detects, reviews, and acts on misuse across those surfaces, where the partner owns the customer relationship and often the data path. You'll build the operating model, partner agreements, and documentation that make enforcement on every cloud consistent, auditable, and fast.

This role requires someone who is detail-oriented, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and capable of coordinating across teams and companies to break new ground and drive work to completion. This work is deeply cross-functional. You'll partner closely with our product managers, policy experts, Safeguards engineering, Legal, and the trust & safety and operations teams across our Cloud partners to maintain a consistent and safe enforcement ecosystem.

Important context for this role: In this position you may be exposed to and engage with explicit content spanning a range of topics, including those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the end to end enforcement lifecycle on partner surfaces, from detection and review through action, customer communication, and appeal

  • Define enforcement paths for each partner's operating model, including how actions are requested, executed, and confirmed when the partner controls the account

  • Manage SLAs for review, escalation, and action, and evaluate performance against them on an ongoing basis

  • Develop and maintain SOPs and escalation guides for all enforcement workflows, ensuring consistency across clouds

  • Establish red-teaming, Quality processes, and operationalize shared metrics

  • Stand up paired investigations with partner threat intelligence teams, including case referrals, indicator sharing, and paging for high severity incidents

  • Own enforcement metrics across partner surfaces and report them to Safeguards leadership, partners, and regulators

Minimum qualifications

  • Extensive experience in trust and safety operations, enforcement, threat intelligence, or a related field

  • Have managed external partner or vendor relationships where you did not control the other side's systems or priorities

  • Comfortable working across policy, legal, engineering, and operations teams to translate requirements into practical workflows

  • Experience building enforcement programs from the ground up, including SLAs, escalation paths, and quality measurement

  • Highly organized, with a track record of maintaining rigorous documentation and SOPs in fast-moving environments

  • Clear and precise communication, both in writing and verbally, across technical and non-technical audiences, including partner executives

  • Energized by the challenge of building scalable systems in an environment where not everything is already figured out

  • Care deeply about the responsible deployment of AI and the role enforcement operations plays in that mission

Preferred qualifications

  • Direct trust & safety, abuse, or security operations experience at AWS, GCP, or Azure, or at a company that ships through their marketplaces

  • Experience designing incident response or escalation processes that span more than one company

  • Familiarity with data access controls, audit requirements, or privacy constrained review environments

  • Experience with law enforcement referrals, regulatory reporting, or compliance programs

  • Background in AI safety, content moderation, fraud, or abuse detection systems

  • Comfort working with data and metrics to inform operational decisions and surface trends to leadership

We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

region: San Francisco, CA / New York City, NY / Washington, DC
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Safeguards Enforcement Lead on the User Well-Being team, you will be responsible for managing our child safety, mental health, abuse and exploitation, and age assurance enforcement workflows. This will include managing the team responsible for scaling, maintaining, and continuously improving the systems and processes we use to detect and respond to these harms.

This is a management role. You will serve as the central point of contact for those who conduct content review, managing day-to-day workflows, quality assurance, and escalation processes. You will also work closely with internal Engineering, Policy, and Legal teams to scale detection systems and close enforcement gaps as the threat landscape evolves.

Important context for this role: In this position you will regularly be exposed to and engage with explicit content of a sexual nature involving minors, as well as content that may be violent or psychologically disturbing. Anthropic takes the wellbeing of team members working in this area seriously and provides access to wellness resources and support. Candidates should carefully consider this aspect of the role before applying.

Key responsibilities

  • Manage a team of individual contributors across multiple policy areas under the User Well-Being banner

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for review partners conducting content review, including onboarding, training, quality assurance, and ongoing relationship management

  • Design and improve enforcement workflows to scale effectively as volume grows, while maintaining high accuracy and consistency across review decisions

  • Partner with Engineering and Data Science teams to optimize detection models and automated enforcement systems for User Well-Being policies

  • Develop and maintain internal documentation, decision trees, and review guidelines that enable accurate and consistent enforcement at scale

  • Keep up to date with emerging AI policy enforcement best practices, evolving legal frameworks, and developments in technology, and use these to inform our workflows

  • Identify and report trends in misuse patterns to internal stakeholders, including Policy, Legal, and Trust & Safety leadership

  • Coordinate reporting obligations to relevant external bodies (e.g., NCMEC) in accordance with applicable law and Anthropic policy

Minimum qualifications

  • Experience managing teams in the User Well-Being space

  • Experience in trust & safety, content moderation operations, or policy enforcement with direct exposure to child safety, mental health, abuse and exploitation, and age assurance harm areas

  • Experience managing or coordinating content review operations, including quality assurance and workflow management

  • Experience standing up and scaling policy enforcement or content review workflows

  • Proficiency in SQL and/or other data analysis tools to monitor workflow health, review queue metrics, and surface enforcement trends

  • Experience identifying emerging risks and communicating findings to cross-functional stakeholders, such as Product, Policy, Engineering, and Legal teams

  • Understanding of the challenges involved in implementing product policies at scale in the content moderation space

Preferred qualifications

  • Deep subject matter expertise in child safety, child sexual exploitation and abuse (CSEA), online child protection, mental wellness, and age assurance

  • Experience working with or reporting to NCMEC, IWF, or equivalent child safety reporting bodies

  • Familiarity with relevant legal and regulatory frameworks, including CSAM reporting obligations, KOSA, COPPA, or equivalent international frameworks

  • Experience working with generative AI products, including an understanding of how AI systems can be misused to generate or facilitate abusive content

  • Experience designing or evaluating trauma-informed support structures and wellness protocols for content reviewers working with harmful material

  • Proficiency in Python for workflow automation or data analysis

  • Experience working with hash-matching technologies (e.g., PhotoDNA, CSAI Match) or perceptual hashing tools used in CSAM detection

  • Familiarity with age assurance technologies and their role in child safety enforcement

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$285,000—$330,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. OpenAI is building the next generation of advertising for an AI-powered world. As AI changes how people discover information, explore possibilities, and make decisions, we believe this presents a huge opportunity for small and medium-sized businesses to connect with customers in new ways.

The SMB Ads Marketing team is building this opportunity from the ground up. You’ll help teams consider the many ways people perceive, understand, navigate, and interact with technology, going beyond minimum compliance to create experiences that are genuinely useful and inclusive.

Working across design, engineering, research, product, go-to-market, and legal, you’ll make accessibility an expected part of product quality—not a final review or the responsibility of a single expert.

title: Procurement Operations Business Partner, R&D Operations
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Procurement Operations is the front door for buying at Anthropic. We sit inside Finance Operations and own the path from “I need to buy something” to a signed agreement, an accurate purchase order, and clean spend data at month-end.

We are hiring a Procurement Operations Business Partner to own that path for our research organizations and the special programs that spawn out of it. This portfolio behaves differently from the rest of the company in that it purchases goods and services from highly-specialized vendors and new programs regularly appear with real purchasing needs before any process exists for them. You will be the person who makes all of that feel simple to the researchers and program leads who depend on it, and reliable to the Finance stakeholders behind it. This is a high-volume role with an accounting core. You ensure every purchase in the portfolio is coded, dated, received, and accrued correctly, so research spend is right in the books every month. Expect a steady queue of requests, work orders, and change orders, and expect to be the person Accounting trusts on all of it.

We use Claude as part of our daily workflow and are looking for someone who wants to help define what an AI-native procurement operations function looks like, including how AI changes intake, document review, vendor coordination, and requester support.

Responsibilities

Own the purchasing path for R&D

  • Manage a high volume of purchase requests, work orders, and change orders each month across research teams and programs, keeping speed and accuracy high at the same time.
  • Serve as the primary procurement partner for Anthropic's research teams and special programs, guiding requesters from initial request to signed agreement and issued purchase order.
  • Review every purchase request in your portfolio for the things that matter downstream: the right vendor record and contracting entity, complete commercial documents, correct spend categorization and service dates, and the approvals the purchase actually needs.
  • Determine what each request requires before it can move, whether that is a statement of work, an order form, an amendment, a security or privacy review, or a third party risk assessment, and route it to the right reviewers the first time.
  • Launch and track contract review with Legal, keep it moving, and confirm the executed agreement supports the purchase order before it is issued.
  • Structure purchase orders so they match how the vendor bills (fixed fee, milestone, per-unit, or usage in arrears) and how Accounting needs to see the spend, with the right GL account, cost center, and service period on every line. Manage change orders, renewals, and closures over the life of each agreement.
  • Act as the dedicated operations partner for our research services vendor portfolio, where engagements are structured as master agreements with frequent work orders and scope changes, and where speed and documentation discipline both matter.
  • Handle the mechanics that come with hardware, equipment, and lab purchasing, including multi line quotes, lead times, shipping and receiving, and asset handoffs.

Financial completeness & accuracy

  • Code every purchase order correctly at creation, including GL account, spend category, cost center, and service period, and understand how each choice lands in the financials (expense vs. prepaid, capitalized equipment vs. operating spend).
  • Work the hard cases with Accounting: services that span periods, partially delivered milestones, per-unit work billed in arrears, credits and true-ups, and work orders amended mid-month.
  • Own the open purchase order book: receipts recorded against actual delivery, periodic reviews, stale line cleanup, coding corrections, and timely closures, so PO, receipt, and invoice agree.
  • Serve as the first line reviewer for month end accruals on your portfolio, gathering estimates from vendors and budget owners for variable spend and confirming or correcting proposed amounts so Accounting can close on time.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable to resolve invoice holds, PO mismatches, and receiving questions so vendors are paid on time and spend lands where it belongs.
  • Support audit and reporting requests that touch your portfolio, including commitment schedules and control evidence, with data you can stand behind.

Stand up new programs

  • Be the first procurement call when a new research program or initiative spins up. Scope what they will buy and how often, agree a right sized path with Legal, Security, and Finance, and have it working before volume arrives.
  • Run a regular pipeline check in with your highest velocity teams so upcoming purchases are visible early and nothing urgent arrives as a surprise.
  • Translate procurement, legal, security, and finance requirements into plain language for researchers and engineers, and carry their operating reality back to those teams so controls fit the work.

Be the front door

  • Be visible and responsive in your teams' Slack channels and office hours; answer routine purchasing questions quickly and escalate real blockers with context.
  • Apply purchasing policy consistently and explain the why, including approval thresholds, signature authority, and when an exception is and is not available.

Continuous improvement

  • Maintain the playbooks, intake guidance, and standard operating procedures for your portfolio so the path is repeatable and does not live in one person's head.
  • Identify manual steps, repeat questions, and failure points and fix them, including where Claude and workflow automation with AI can take work off requesters and the team.

Minimum qualifications

  • Proven track record of owning a high-volume purchasing portfolio end-to-end in procure-to-pay and intake platform.
  • Solid working knowledge of accrual accounting as it applies to purchasing: accruals and reversals, service period and cutoff, prepaid vs. expense, and GL and cost center coding. You can explain how a purchase order becomes an entry in the general ledger.
  • Experience supporting outsourced or managed service vendors at scale, where scope and volume move month to month and the contracts, purchase orders, and invoices have to keep up with each other.
  • Working knowledge of how contract review, security and privacy review, and financial controls fit together in a purchase, and the judgment to know when to push a request through and when to slow it down.

Preferred qualifications

  • 5-7+ years of procurement operations, purchasing, or vendor operations, including time supporting a research, engineering, hardware, or outsourced services organization.
  • Experience as the embedded procurement partner for a hyper scaling data operations, ML, RL, and lab environments
  • Time at a hypergrowth technology company scaling procurement operations for outsourced or vendor delivered work.
  • Background in accounting, accounts payable, or a month-end close process, including experience with three-way match
  • Sourced human data, data labeling, annotation, or evaluation vendors (or comparable BPO and outsourced operations) with a point of view on where that market is heading
  • Direct experience with Zip, Workday Financials, and Ironclad.
  • Prior ownership of month end accrual review or open PO reconciliation for a large, variable spend portfolio
  • Experience designing tiered intake or approval frameworks that sped up low risk purchases without weakening controls.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
About Us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.


Our People

With over 1,500 team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.


Our Impact

As of mid 2025, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.

About the Role

We are seeking a Staff Product Designer who can lead high-impact product design work across multiple teams, connect adjacent product experiences and turn complex problem spaces into coherent shipped outcomes. You have spent 8+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy, AI-enabled or similarly sophisticated product experiences.

As a staff individual contributor, you will operate across product areas where the right solution depends on more than one roadmap, team or feature brief. You will partner deeply with Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Design leadership and customer-facing teams to frame the right problems, define product experience direction and help teams move from ambiguity to high-quality execution.

This role requires exceptional craft, strong product judgment and the ability to balance strategic influence with hands-on design work. You should be comfortable defining experience direction, mapping complex workflows, prototyping new interaction models, strengthening shared patterns and helping teams preserve quality through implementation.

Design systems are an important part of this role, but not the whole role. You will use systems, patterns, accessibility standards and reusable components to connect product experiences while still leading original, customer-centered design work for high-impact product areas.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You'll Do

  • Lead design strategy and execution for complex initiatives that span multiple teams, product surfaces or customer workflows

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, technical constraints, data signals and product strategy into clear experience direction

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to clarify problem spaces, sequence design work and align teams around high-quality outcomes

  • Create prototypes, workflows, interaction models and high-fidelity designs that make complex product ideas tangible and testable

  • Identify product experience gaps, design debt and cross-team inconsistencies, then turn them into practical improvements

  • Shape AI-enabled workflows, intelligent interfaces and automation-heavy experiences that give customers clarity, control and confidence

  • Strengthen shared patterns, design-system adoption, accessibility standards and implementation guidance across adjacent product areas

  • Mentor senior and lead designers through critique, coaching, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale

  • Collaborate effectively across US and India time zones in a 100% remote environment

What We Are Looking For

  • 8+ years of relevant product design experience, leading complex, ambiguous and high-impact initiatives across multiple teams or product areas

  • An exceptional portfolio that demonstrates staff-level craft, product judgment, customer empathy, systems thinking, measurable impact and shipped product quality

  • Experience shaping product direction beyond a single feature or team, with the ability to connect adjacent workflows into coherent customer experiences

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility, content quality and implementation detail

  • Proven experience across the design lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing

  • Strong prototyping fluency, including the ability to use Figma, Framer, AI coding tools or lightweight front-end code to make complex ideas tangible

  • Experience designing AI-powered, automation-heavy or intelligent product experiences where customers need transparency, control, trust and useful guidance

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to align teams through customer insight, business rationale, data, prototypes and craft

  • A collaborative, low-ego leadership style with a track record of mentoring designers, improving critique and raising standards

How You Work

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking, prototyping and hands-on design execution

  • You lead through influence, clarity and credibility across teams that may not report into the same roadmap or operating rhythm

  • You are a maker as well as a strategist, using prototypes, AI-assisted tools and practical technical fluency to make ideas concrete quickly

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design

title: Client Partner, Ads Solutions - Travel
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Sales team partners with advertisers to understand their businesses, develop meaningful advertising solutions, and drive long-term growth on the platform while maintaining strong standards for user trust and platform integrity.

About the Role

This role will focus on growing advertising revenue across the Travel vertical, including airlines, hotels, online travel agencies, tourism boards, travel marketplaces, cruise lines, and adjacent travel brands.

You will own the full sales cycle—from prospecting through deal closure—and build strategic relationships with senior travel-industry decision-makers. You’ll help advertisers reach high-intent audiences, improve campaign performance, and develop long-term commercial partnerships that support their business goals.

You will work closely with Account Managers and cross-functional partners to ensure successful advertiser outcomes after the sale, while maintaining primary ownership of revenue growth, commercial strategy, and Travel vertical expertise.

In this role, you will:

  • Prospect, qualify, and close new advertising opportunities across the Travel vertical.

  • Own and achieve a defined revenue target across an assigned portfolio of travel advertisers.

  • Build relationships with senior advertising, marketing, ecommerce, loyalty, and revenue-management leaders.

  • Develop account plans that connect advertiser goals—such as bookings, destination awareness, loyalty acquisition, app adoption, and seasonal demand—to measurable campaign outcomes.

  • Identify opportunities across major travel moments, including peak booking periods, holidays, events, route launches, destination campaigns, and loyalty promotions.

  • Structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements.

  • Build clear, data-driven business cases that demonstrate advertiser ROI and long-term platform value.

  • Partner with Account Managers to support seamless post-sale transitions, campaign success, renewals, and expansion.

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Policy, and Operations to support complex deals and inform future advertising solutions.

  • Maintain strong pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and a deep understanding of Travel industry trends.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 10+ years of experience in digital advertising, performance marketing, client strategy, consulting, or enterprise sales.

  • Have experience working with Travel advertisers, such as airlines, hotels, cruise line, online travel agencies, travel marketplaces, or tourism boards.

  • Have 3+ years of experience advising and influencing senior executives and client stakeholders.

  • Have a proven track record of owning revenue targets and closing complex advertising or commercial deals.

  • Understand travel customer journeys, booking behavior, seasonality, loyalty programs, and performance metrics.

  • Can create compelling business cases and translate advertiser objectives into measurable partnership strategies.

  • Have strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Can operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.

  • Are excited to help shape a new advertising platform while maintaining high standards for user experience, trust, and responsible growth.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy

title: Partner Operations & Systems Lead
description:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

Supabase's Partnerships function is scaling fast - spanning Technology Partners, Solution Partners, Startups, and Cloud Partnerships. We're looking for a Partner Operations & Systems Lead to own the operational and technical backbone that lets this team move quickly and make decisions with good data.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You'll design the systems, processes, and reporting that the whole partnerships org runs on - and, increasingly, you'll build the internal tools yourself. Supabase is investing heavily in AI-assisted development to move faster than a traditional ops build cycle allows, and this role is expected to be a leading example of that inside Partnerships.

You'll report directly to the Head of Partnerships and sit alongside our regional and functional leads as a peer, with the mandate to build and enforce operational rigor across all teams.

Beyond the infrastructure, we want someone who helps shape where Partnerships places its bets - not just the system that reports on them.

What You'll Own

Systems & Data Infrastructure

  • Own the partner tech stack end-to-end - CRM partner objects, attribution tooling, and partner-facing portals.

  • Design and maintain partner attribution models and the dashboards leadership uses to evaluate performance.

  • Ensure data hygiene and consistency across partner records, deals, and touchpoints spanning all sub-functions.

Process & Program Management

  • Design and run partner onboarding, tiering, and certification programs.

  • Own the RFC / DRI decision-making framework for the partnerships team, including how it's used and refined over time.

  • Run deal-registration and "quarterback" account-ownership processes that keep internal teams aligned on partner-sourced deals.

  • Build and maintain the playbooks, SOPs, and enablement materials that let the team scale without you in every meeting.

Internal Tooling & Automation

  • Build internal automations that remove manual ops work - e.g., auto-generated partner performance reports, HubSpot-to-Slack syncs, or deal-conflict alerts - using AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code.

  • Prototype and ship lightweight internal apps and dashboards (partner health scorecards, RFC trackers, cross-tool syncs) without waiting on a shared data engineering backlog.

  • Act as technical owner for partnerships' internal tools: write the spec, build it, test it, ship it, and maintain it.

  • Know where the line is between a quick internal script and something that needs to be handed to Data/Engineering for production hardening - and manage that handoff cleanly.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Produce recurring performance reporting on partner-attributed revenue and pipeline influence.

  • Own the metrics and KPI framework the partnerships team is measured against.

  • Support QBRs and board-level reporting on partnership performance.

Strategic Contribution

  • Contribute to partner segmentation, tiering, and prioritization strategy - bringing data and operational reality to bear on where the team should invest.

  • Challenge existing assumptions in the partner motion (which tiers, which incentive structures, which sub-functions get resourced) using evidence from the systems you own.

  • Partner with the Head of Partnerships on strategic planning cycles - translating operational signal into recommendations, not just dashboards.

  • Own execution of agreed strategic direction: once a call is made, drive the operational and cross-functional work to make it real.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the connective tissue between Partnerships, Sales, RevOps, Legal, and Finance.

  • Ensure partner agreement terms are correctly reflected in systems and reporting.

  • Sit at the table for partner segmentation, tiering, and incentive-structure decisions as a contributor and challenger, not just an operator reporting on them after the fact.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years in partner operations, revenue operations, or a related ops function, including experience designing (not just running) a program at scale.

  • Proven ownership of a partner or revenue tech stack - you've made the build/buy/migrate calls, not just administered someone else's setup.

  • Comfortable operating as the operational voice in exec-level rooms - QBRs, board prep, and cross-functional planning.

  • Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted development (Claude Code or similar) - you can scope a problem, prompt effectively, review the output critically, and ship something real.

  • A point of view on partner economics - rev share modeling, LTV by partner type - that can inform deal structuring, not just track it after signature.

  • A track record of shaping strategic decisions, not just implementing them - comfortable pressure-testing a plan in the room and then owning the execution once direction is set.

  • Experience managing a small team or dotted-line relationships across regions or sub-functions.

  • Excellent written communication - you can turn ambiguity into a clear framework or a one-page decision doc.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with HubSpot (custom partner objects, multi-touch attribution), Clazar for cloud co-sell, and Linear for project management.

  • Background in a developer-tools or platform business with a partner-driven go-to-market motion.

  • Prior experience building internal tools or scripts, even informally, before AI-assisted development made it mainstream.

How We'll Evaluate

Alongside standard interviews, candidates will complete a short build exercise: given a messy partner-data problem, show us how you'd use Claude Code (or a similar tool) to solve it. We're evaluating judgment and problem-scoping as much as the output itself.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP
